audience: finance teams that pay out, track and reconcile PiggyVest Business API wallets

useCases.title: Check wallet balances and funding accounts
useCases.text: List the API wallets with the total balance. Read one wallet, and the bank account numbers that fund it.

useCases.title: Trace transactions and their status
useCases.text: List transactions with filters for wallet, status, direction and dates. Check the status of one transfer by its reference.

useCases.title: Check the payee name before a bank transfer
useCases.text: List the bank codes, then resolve the account name. Confirm that the name matches the payee before you pay.

useCases.title: Pay a bank account
useCases.text: Resolve the payee name first. The payment tool runs only with confirm set to true. The reply is processing, so check the result by its reference.

useCases.title: Schedule or cancel a recurring payment
useCases.text: Schedule a one-time or recurring payment from a wallet. Cancel a scheduled payment with is_active set to false, so it makes no more runs.
